title: Action-outcome coupling: a pre-investment feasibility audit for offline reinforcement learning in supply chain operations
abstract: arXiv:2611.22921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prescriptive analytics initiatives in logistics, such as offline reinforcement learning and next-best-action systems, are often funded before anyone verifies that the available historical logs can support an improved decision policy. We formalise this pre-investment feasibility question via action-outcome coupling: a total-effect variance index measuring how much expected outcomes change with the logged action. Coupling provides an algorithm-independent upper bound on any policy's achievable value, expressed in monetary units per decision for both single-step and discounted sequential objectives. We also analyse the asymptotic false-licensing risk of an invalid workflow: fitting a value model and evaluating the model's greedy policy on the same data. translated_title: 动作-结果耦合：供应链运营中离线强化学习的投资前可行性审计
translated_abstract: 物流领域的规范性分析计划（如离线强化学习和下一步最佳行动系统）往往在任何人验证现有历史日志能否支撑改进后的决策策略之前就已获得资金投入。我们通过“动作-结果耦合”（action-outcome coupling）将这一投资前可行性问题形式化：这是一个衡量期望结果随已记录动作变化程度的总效应方差指标。耦合为任何策略可实现的价值提供了与算法无关的上界，该上界以每次决策的货币单位表示，同时适用于单步目标和折扣序列目标。我们还分析了一种无效工作流的渐近虚假许可风险：在同一数据上拟合价值模型并评估该模型的贪心策略。虚假许可率主要由执行选择的状态单元数量驱动：当只有一个状态单元时，虚假许可率处于名义检验水平；当状态单元达到几十个时，虚假许可率则接近必然。
tldr: 本文提出“动作-结果耦合”这一总效应方差指标，作为供应链离线强化学习投资前的可行性审计工具，为任何策略的价值提供与算法无关的货币化上界，并揭示在同一数据上拟合与评估价值模型会随状态单元数增加而导致近乎必然的虚假许可风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "action-outcome coupling," a total-effect variance index serving as a pre-investment feasibility audit for offline reinforcement learning in supply chain operations, providing an algorithm-independent monetary upper bound on any policy's achievable value, and revealing that fitting and evaluating a value model on the same data leads to a false-licensing risk approaching certainty as the number of state cells grows.
